Why Each Item on This List Matters

Each item on this list matters because it addresses a specific pain point or limitation that digital creators in Pakistan face. The use of Tron's USDT, for example, enables instant and low-cost settlements, while Binance P2P allows for peer-to-peer transactions in local currencies. Finally, Google Drive offers a reliable and fast file delivery and sharing solution.

How can I set up a payment gateway like NOWPayments?

To set up NOWPayments, simply sign up for an account, generate a payment button, and integrate it into your website or application. This will enable automatic on-chain crypto payment verification and reduce the risk of chargebacks and disputes.
What is the difference between Cloudflare Pages and Cloudflare Workers?

Cloudflare Pages is a hosting solution that enables you to host your website or application, while Cloudflare Workers is a serverless platform that allows you to run backend logic and automation. Both solutions are essential for building a scalable and secure digital commerce business.
Can I use Supabase for order storage and management?
Yes, Supabase is a powerful database solution that enables you to store and manage orders, customers, and other data. It's a great alternative to traditional databases like MySQL or PostgreSQL.
How can I implement file delivery and sharing with Google Drive?
